rules.rule_en: Homonyms are spelled the same way but differ in meaning.
Two or more words having the same spelling and pronunciation but different meanings and origins.
Confusables are words that are commonly confused with one another in meaning or usage because of slight similarities in spelling, pronunciation or meaning.
Homographs are words with same spelling but different meanings and sometimes different pronunciation.
Heteronyms (also known as heterophones) are two or more words with same spelling but different sounds and meanings.
Homophones are words that sound the same but have different meanings, origins and spellings.

Antigrams are a pair of anagrams with opposite meanings.
